claims.claim: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR) and Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. (NASDAQ: FFAI) will co‑host a new product launch on October 14, 2026.

claims.evidence: 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR), a U.S.-based Embodied AI ("EAI") robotics company that has proposed to acquire Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc.'s (NASDAQ: FFAI) EAI Robotics business, today highlighted FFAI's announcement that this week's Investor Weekly Report from Faraday Future ("FF") Founder and Global CEO YT Jia has been rescheduled to October 14.
